newsitem.title: USA: MicroEnergy Q3 results below company plan.
newsitem.headline: MicroEnergy Q3 results below company plan.

text.p: MicroEnergy Inc said Friday that net income and sales for its third quarter and the first nine months of its fiscal year were below the company's operating plan.
"Sales and corresponding net income for the quarter and nine months ended March 31, 1996, are somewhat behind our operating plan," Robert Fanella, chief financial officer, said in a statement.
He said, however, the company expects to see continuning improvements in average monthly sales volume as additional new programs come on line.
"It will take several continuing quarters, however, to bring net income to a level sufficient to cover our required semiannual (preferred) dividend payment," Fanella said.
The company said preferred stock dividend payments decrease the net income under generally accepted accounting rules.
MicroEnergy on Friday reported a third quarter net loss of $0.162 a share versus a net profit of $2.998 a share, including a $2.858 a share one-time gain.
